segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone/resilient skin report the cleanser removes excess oil and makeup without over-drying, though one reviewer with oily skin reported breaking out and feeling oilier the next day.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report the cleanser cleans without stripping, tightness, or leaving skin dry, often noting a hydrated, smooth finish afterward.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report the cleanser balances oil while removing makeup and sunscreen effectively, leaving skin comfortable rather than tight.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation and a gentle, non-stripping cleanse, though one reviewer with sensitive/reactive skin warns the fragrance and some ingredients can trigger reactions.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe skin as hydrated, soft, and never tight or stripped after rinsing, including several with dry skin; no reviewer reports increased dryness.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports the cleanser kept her skin from getting red; no other reviewer discusses redness specifically.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the cleanser with helping restore her skin barrier through gentle daily use; others describe skin as 'balanced' and 'not stripped,' consistent with barrier support.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone skin report the product is gentle and non-comedogenic with no new breakouts, but one reviewer reports breaking out the next day and oilier skin after use.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including those with oily skin, report the cleanser controls oil and leaves skin balanced rather than greasy; one reviewer reports the opposite, feeling oilier after use.

aspects.libelle: Large bottle seen as good value

extraits.texte: Detox Face Cleanser is a rather thick, clear gel cleanser that foams up much more than anticipated. A little goes a long with this texture. It is slightly drying/stripping but not excessively so. I wasn't a fan of this minty fragrance (I believe it's Dean Street) and it contains some ingredients that will trigger sensitive/reactive skin. I would only recommend for combo/oily & resilient skin. Complimentary from OUAI.

I wanted to love this cleanser but it just didn't work for me. I broke out the next day after using this and my skin seemed so much oilier than usual. This has an odd fragrance to it as well, which could have been what cause me to break out. Gifted by Ouai.

I have dry skin and this cleanser foams lightly and gives a deep clean feel without making my skin tight. It's great on days when I wear sunscreen or feel I need extra clean skin. The scent is fresh but not overpowering. After rinsing it off, my face feels clean and smooth, not stripped. I follow up with my favorite serum and moisturizer. Gifted by Ouai in exchange for my honest review

I have very oily skin, so a good morning cleanse is essential for me, and this one never disappoints. It gives my skin a deep, refreshing clean without feeling harsh or drying. It easily removes excess oil, sweat, and leftover makeup, and my skin always feels fresh and balanced afterward. The creamy lather rinses off beautifully and leaves my face smooth and comfortable. I'm currently on my second bottle of the Ouai Detox Face Cleanser, which says everything—this is a product I genuinely trust and keep coming back to. gifted by ouai

I absolutely adore this face wash, especially as someone with acne-prone, sensitive skin. I always check every product I purchase to make sure it doesn't clog my pores. I was so happy to discover that this product is acne-safe. It cleanses my face without stripping it, and it removes makeup well. I love having this in my shower. It's become my go-to product.

gifted by ouai - i love ouai hair products and excited to see that they now have a face wash?! its in their signature, sleek chubby bottles. i have sensitive and dry skin and so far, it doesnt strip my skin's moisture and so far it helps keep my skin clean!

This Ouai cleanser has helped me restore my skin barrier because it's super gentle on my sensitive skin, I tend to wash my face multiple times in a day so I needed something that wouldn't strip my barrier. Love this gifted by ouai
